title: Filtered colimits and tensor complexes of sheaves of modules
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site whose underlying category is small and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. Filtered colimits in the abelian category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules are exact. If $(\mathcal F_i^\bullet)_{i\in I}$ is a filtered diagram of cochain complexes of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] and $\mathcal P^\bullet$ is a fixed such complex, then the canonical termwise colimit isomorphism of total tensor complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]

$$\operatorname{Tot}((\varinjlim_i\mathcal F_i^\bullet)\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal P^\bullet)\cong\varinjlim_i\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal F_i^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal P^\bullet)$$

holds, where the colimit on complexes is taken degreewise in the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules.

source.place: Lemmas 03DB (limits and colimits of O-modules) and 03EP (tensor product commutes with colimits)

proof.text: The category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules is Grothendieck abelian, and its filtered colimits are exact, by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] (the standard small-site size convention is understood, and an essentially small site may be replaced by an equivalent small one). Thus filtered colimits preserve kernels and cokernels and therefore commute with cohomology objects of cochain complexes.

source.place: Section 07A5, first paragraph; Modules on Sites Lemmas 03DA and 03DB

proof.text: For a fixed sheaf of modules $\mathcal P$, the functor $-\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal P$ preserves all colimits because $\Mod(\mathcal O)$ is closed symmetric monoidal and tensoring is a left adjoint, by [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. Applying this degreewise to a filtered diagram of complexes identifies each term of the tensor complex of the colimit with the filtered colimit of the corresponding tensor-complex terms; the identification is compatible with the differentials because all structure maps are functorial.

source.place: Lemma 03EP (lemma-tensor-commute-colimits), applied termwise to the tensor-complex construction

proof.text: In each total degree the direct-sum totalization is a colimit over the set of pairs of degrees with fixed sum. Colimits commute with colimits, so the filtered colimit commutes with this direct sum. Combining this with Step 2 gives a canonical termwise isomorphism $\operatorname{Tot}((\varinjlim_i F_i^\bullet)\otimes_{\mathcal O}P^\bullet)\cong\varinjlim_i\operatorname{Tot}(F_i^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}P^\bullet)$, and compatibility with the total differential follows from the defining signed sum in [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. The preservation comparison is packaged by [lem-pc-module-filtered-colimits-tensor-preserves].
